Cause: Regeneration heater open circuit (25% of cases). Action: Isolate power, check regeneration heater resistance; replace if open. Done by: technician. Typical time: 75 min. Parts: MT-DHD-RHTR INR 8950. Cause: Air filter clogged with fines or dust (20% of cases). Action: Stop blower, remove filter, clean with compressed air from clean side or replace if torn.
